description: Regression fixture for the over-seeding / two-rules-in-one-test lesson (the failure that motivated the ordered-test-list work). One test named for a single rule (distinct user ids) but seeded with THREE rows for USER_A and one for USER_B, so its `hasSize(2)` does work for two rules at once — deduplication (multiple rows per user collapse) AND multi-user enumeration. The minimal seed for the named rule is one row each for two users; the extra duplicate rows are over-specification exercising a second rule. The test-reviewer must flag it (split / one-behavior-per-test / over-specified seed). We assert FAIL coarsely.
